notes: NEW PAYE RATES FROM 1 SEPTEMBER 2026: payroll uses the Income Tax (Amendment) Act, 2026 (Act 1178) bands from September's payroll, and the old bands for August and earlier, with nothing to enter; if you already ran September's payroll, open it after installing and follow the warning on the Monthly run. ORGANISATION PROFILE: choose your sector and framework (IFRS, IFRS for SMEs, IPSAS) in Settings and the statements follow it; until you do, every report reads exactly as before. NEW: Customers with statements, ageing and proformas; several Stores with transfers, requisitions and goods received; Fuel Cards by vehicle; Deposits and Investments; Borrowings with repayment schedules; Prepayments and Accruals released month by month; Corporate Income Tax with provisional tax; Sales Import from your till with recipes; Bank Payment Files for salaries and suppliers; and tax and VAT withheld from you by customers, set off where they belong. Screens you do not use can be hidden in Settings, Modules. INSTALLING: this version adds new tables to your books the first time they are opened; no existing figure changes. Take a backup of every company first: Backup and Export, Back up now.
